What is in this candidate
  * Smokey Castle results-screen portraits fixed (issue #25), plus the
    hardware-accurate HUD clipping that fix is built on.
  * The presentation / motion-smoothing work: effect shells anchored to their
    own tick, camera cuts never blended, retained-pointer fail-closed, rotation
    snap past a quarter turn, one-frame swap-chain latency.
  * Motion smoothing and the camera correction remain OFF by default and are
    not recommended in the launcher. Nothing here changes that.

NOT a release
  No tag, no GitHub release, no web demo push. These exist only for the device
  acceptance pass described in docs/DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE_SMOOTHING.md.
